_comment: Snippet showing how to wire the PreToolUse tool-stream hook in a Claude Code settings.json.
_instructions: Copy the 'hooks' block into your ~/.claude/settings.json (or per-project .claude/settings.json).
Adjust the path to discord-tool-notify.js to wherever you installed fleet-discord.
The hook fires before every tool call. It exits 0 immediately unless DISCORD_TOOL_STREAM=1
is set (either in process env or in your plugin .env file), and unless the session has an
active busy file (i.e. it's currently handling a Discord message). This means it's silent
during all non-Discord work — no overhead for regular sessions.
To enable streaming for a session, add DISCORD_TOOL_STREAM=1 to:
